impact: The one-hour flat count was an eligibility bottleneck: there was no new L4 package at accepted plus archived state; per-question steps had to finish in order, and one L4 remained draft. This turn completed and submitted the L4 injury package, moving the verified total from 16 to 17. The browser submit took about three minutes; its auxiliary browse Agent produced no output, so the bounded route is to stop waiting, preserve its warning, and submit only after local package validation when the platform confirms submission is allowed.

lesson: 推进以每题当前版本的ready状态为准，避免整批阶段屏障；优先L4，L4被前置条件阻塞时用L2填容量。网页Agent是平台辅助检查，不是本地ZIP核验的替代；无输出时不无限等待，平台警告与人工本地核验必须分别记载。
